claim_boundary: This audit establishes a source-integrity failure, not benchmark accuracy, formulation accuracy, or a treatment effect.
The trusted custodian parsed source records mechanically but exposed no task body, data value, optimal value, model text, or reference program in public evidence or to an inference process.
The 220 exact instances are not substituted as a post-audit cohort; no exclusion, rename, inferred mapping, or guessed download is authorized.
Repository-level CC BY-SA 4.0 labeling does not by itself settle redistribution treatment of every upstream MIPLIB-derived file.

decision.reason: The fixed official source is a distinct candidate lineage, but its declared and materialized input paths disagree in three instances; the full answer-blind custody rehearsal therefore failed before publication.

answer_blind_custody.reason: Synthetic projection, privacy, publication, replay and drift tests pass, but the fixed-source full bundle cannot be published while source materialization fails.

frozen_selector.reason: Selection is prohibited after the source-integrity failure; 220 exact instances cannot be adopted post audit.

packet_completeness.reason: The 43 absent model.md files are represented explicitly, but three instances also fail required input-path completeness; no 223-item inference/evaluator packet exists.

reference_access_contract.reason: Evaluator-only projection code exists, but no full fixed-source evaluator bundle can be frozen while five declared inputs are absent.

resource_contract.reason: No selector or resource cohort may be frozen from a source that fails complete materialization.

rights_safe_public_input_route.reason: The official README labels the repository CC BY-SA 4.0, but attribution, share-alike, upstream MIPLIB-derived-file treatment, and any redistribution projection still require an explicit release review.

same_knowledge_serializer.reason: No serializer may be frozen until a complete canonical inference packet exists.

scoreable_endpoint.reason: A plausible reference route exists, but the release is not fully materialized and no exact endpoint contract has been frozen.

source_lineage.reason: This is a newly fixed MIPLIB-2017-derived source lineage distinct from the already opened Text2Opt, TSP, OR-Debug, and DCP cohorts.

source_materialization.reason: Only 220/223 instances have exact declared/actual data-path sets; three mismatch, with five declared files absent and five materialized files undeclared.

untouched_endpoint_outcomes.reason: Reference values were parsed only inside the trusted custodian, never rendered, scored, used for selection, or exposed to inference or the human-visible audit.

next_required_actions: Keep the current fixed release non-dispatchable and monitor only for an official hash-bound correction of the declared/materialized path mismatches.
Do not silently rename, infer, download, exclude, or replace any of the five mismatched paths.
If no official correction is available, qualify a different untouched source through the same source, custody, rights, resource, endpoint, selector, and serializer gates.
Only after a complete zero-model/no-solver custody rehearsal may a same-knowledge experiment plan be frozen.
